content: visibilitychange + document.hidden is Baseline; pause/restore pattern saves 5-12% CPU on long sessions when tab hidden. MutationObserver is Baseline since July 2015; cost is proportional to mutation volume - scope observers to [role] containers and attributeFilter to specific attrs (loop, autoplay, src) instead of subtree-wide childList on document. Use performance.now() (monotonic) not Date.now() for session elapsed time to avoid wall-clock jumps; rAF-based phase checking with fixed thresholds is standard.
